**English** | [简体中文](./README.zh-CN.md) [![CI](https://github.com/ZJUSCODE/antigravity-agent-bridge/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/ZJUSCODE/antigravity-agent-bridge/actions/workflows/ci.yml) [![Node.js >= 22.5](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%3E%3D22.5.0-5fa04e)](https://nodejs.org/) [![Zero Dependencies](https://img.shields.io/badge/dependencies-0-007acc)](#) [![Platforms](https://img.shields.io/badge/platform-Windows%20%7C%20macOS%20%7C%20Linux-informational)](#) [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-blue.svg)](./LICENSE) [![LINUX DO](https://img.shields.io/badge/Community-LINUX%20DO-f0a500?logo=discourse&logoColor=white)](https://linux.do/) **Turn Google Antigravity into a Multi-Agent Command Center & Peer-Review Roundtable.** Connect **OpenAI Codex**, **Pi Coding Agent**, **Anthropic Claude Code**, **Google Gemini CLI**, **OpenCode**, and **any custom CLI coding agent** inside Antigravity's native right-hand Auxiliary Pane — with **0 external npm dependencies**.
--- ## Why `antigravity-agent-bridge`? Modern AI-assisted engineering rarely relies on a single model. Architects often want **Antigravity** to plan a spec, **OpenAI Codex** or **Pi** to implement backend/frontend changes, and **Claude Code** or **Gemini CLI** to perform independent adversarial code review — without copy-pasting prompts across 4 terminal windows. **`antigravity-agent-bridge`** solves this natively inside **Google Antigravity**: - **Native Aux-Pane Roundtable UI**: Embeds directly into Antigravity's right-hand Sidecar pane, binding live to Antigravity's `:root` theme CSS variables (`Light`, `Dark`, and custom themes update in the exact same frame with zero visual seam) and following your active Antigravity conversation **1:1**. - **5 Built-In Streaming Agent Drivers + Extensible Custom Adapters**: | Agent | CLI Binary | Streaming Protocol | Stateful Session Resume | Read-Only / Write Sandboxing | | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **OpenAI Codex** | `codex` | Persistent `app-server --stdio` JSON-RPC v2 | `thread/resume` + safe `thread/fork` | `--sandbox` + live approval cards | | **Pi Agent** | `pi` | `pi --mode json -p` NDJSON | `--session-id ` | `--tools read,grep,find,ls` vs full | | **Claude Code** | `claude` | `claude -p --output-format stream-json` | `--resume ` | `--permission-mode plan` vs `acceptEdits` | | **Gemini CLI** | `gemini` | `gemini -p --output-format stream-json` | `--resume ` | Read-only vs `--yolo` | | **OpenCode** | `opencode` | `opencode run --format json` | `-s ` | Scoped workspace execution | | **Custom CLI** | *Any CLI* | Declarative `agents.custom.json` | Optional template | Custom args (`Aider`, `Qwen`, `Goose`…) | - **Parallel Multi-Agent Council ("群策圆桌")**: Broadcast one architectural RFC or uncommitted `git diff` to **all installed agents in parallel** (`--agent council` or `--agents codex,pi,claude`), watching each agent stream its independent verdict into the same room. - **Adaptive Convergence-Driven Rounds (`1..N`)**: No rigid "2-round" or "3-round" limits — Antigravity autonomously governs the number of discussion or review-fix-verify rounds based on task complexity and peer convergence signals (`[PEER_STATUS: CONVERGED | NEEDS_ROUND]`, `[PEER_VERDICT: PASS | CHANGES_REQUIRED]`), stopping in 1 round when aligned or iterating 4+ rounds until every `P0/P1` issue is resolved. - **Architect → Executor Dispatch**: Tell Antigravity in plain language: *"Design the plan yourself, dispatch implementation & tests to Codex / Pi / Claude, and iterate review-and-fix rounds until the diff passes."* - **Bidirectional Peer Skills**: Installs `agent-bridge` & `codex-chat` into Antigravity **and** automatically installs the reverse `antigravity-chat` skill into `~/.codex/skills/`, `~/.pi/agent/skills/`, and `~/.claude/skills/` so external agents can consult local Antigravity (`agy`) too — guarded by `AGY_CODEX_PEER_CALL=1` hardware-level anti-recursion locks. --- ## 30-Second Quickstart (Windows / macOS / Linux / WSL 2) **Prerequisites**: - **Node.js `>= 22.5.0`** (uses built-in `node:sqlite` — zero C++ native compilation or `npm install` bloat!) - [Google Antigravity](https://antigravity.google) + **at least one** coding agent CLI (`codex`, `pi`, `claude`, `gemini`, or `opencode`). ### macOS / Linux / WSL 2 ```bash git clone https://github.com/ZJUSCODE/antigravity-agent-bridge.git "$HOME/.gemini/config/plugins/codex-bridge" cd "$HOME/.gemini/config/plugins/codex-bridge" npm run setup npm run doctor ``` ### Windows (PowerShell) ```powershell git clone https://github.com/ZJUSCODE/antigravity-agent-bridge.git "$HOME\.gemini\config\plugins\codex-bridge" cd "$HOME\.gemini\config\plugins\codex-bridge" npm run setup npm run doctor ``` Then simply talk to Antigravity in plain language: - *"Open the Aux-Pane Roundtable and debate our database sharding design with **Codex** until you both converge on the schema."* - *"Design the API contract yourself, dispatch implementation and unit tests to **Pi** (or **Claude Code**), and iterate until your diff review passes."* - *"Run a parallel **Council** code review (`Codex + Pi + Claude`) on my uncommitted Git changes."* --- ## Architecture Overview ```mermaid flowchart LR A["Google Antigravity\n(Main Chat + Architect)"] <-->|"agent-bridge / codex-chat\n+ Aux-Pane Sidecar HTTP"| B["Universal Bridge Kernel\n(PID Leases · Epoch Fencing · SQLite WAL)"] B <--> C1["OpenAI Codex\n(app-server RPC)"] B <--> C2["Pi Agent\n(--mode json)"] B <--> C3["Claude Code\n(stream-json)"] B <--> C4["Gemini CLI / OpenCode\n+ Custom JSON Adapters"] ``` ### Adding Any Custom CLI Agent in 10 Lines (`agents.custom.json`) Copy [`agents.example.json`](./agents.example.json) to `agents.custom.json` inside the plugin root to register **Aider**, **Qwen Code**, **Goose**, **Cursor Agent**, or internal enterprise tools — they immediately light up in both the Sidecar UI picker and `talk_agent.mjs`! --- ## CLI Usage & Diagnostics ```bash # Inspect all detected coding agents, models, and health checks: npm run doctor # Run the 17 automated concurrency, path-sandbox, NDJSON streaming & HTTP long-polling tests: npm test # Cleanly remove reverse peer skills from ~/.codex, ~/.pi, and ~/.claude: npm run uninstall-bridge ``` --- ## Community, Contributing & License - **Community Acknowledgment**: Proudly shared with and supported by the **[LINUX DO](https://linux.do/)** developer community. - **Contributing**: Contributions, new agent adapters, and issue reports are warmly welcome! See [CONTRIBUTING.md](./CONTRIBUTING.md). - **License**: Released under the [MIT License](./LICENSE).

[English](./README.md) | **简体中文** [![CI](https://github.com/ZJUSCODE/antigravity-agent-bridge/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/ZJUSCODE/antigravity-agent-bridge/actions/workflows/ci.yml) [![Node.js >= 22.5](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%3E%3D22.5.0-5fa04e)](https://nodejs.org/) [![Zero Dependencies](https://img.shields.io/badge/dependencies-0-007acc)](#) [![Platforms](https://img.shields.io/badge/platform-Windows%20%7C%20macOS%20%7C%20Linux-informational)](#) [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-blue.svg)](./LICENSE) [![LINUX DO](https://img.shields.io/badge/Community-LINUX%20DO-f0a500?logo=discourse&logoColor=white)](https://linux.do/) **把 Google Antigravity 升级为「多智能体协同指挥中心与同屏圆桌对讲室」。** 零第三方 `npm` 依赖，在 Antigravity 右侧原生辅助栏一键连接 **OpenAI Codex**、**Pi Agent**、**Anthropic Claude Code**、**Google Gemini CLI**、**OpenCode** 及任意自定义 CLI 智能体！
--- ## 一、为什么需要 `antigravity-agent-bridge`？ 在真实研发中，不同智能体各有所长：你可能希望由 **Antigravity** 统筹需求与架构决策，指派 **OpenAI Codex** 攻坚后端核心算法、**Pi** 或 **Claude Code** 编写前端与单测，或者让它们对同一份 `git diff` **并行开展对抗式交叉 Code Review**——而不是自己在四五个终端窗口之间来回复制粘贴。 **`antigravity-agent-bridge`（v5.0）** 在 Antigravity 内部原生打通了这一闭环： 1. **100% 原生 Antigravity 界面风格与实时主题同步** - 直接绑定 Antigravity 宿主实时注入 `:root` 的主题变量（`--background`、`--foreground`、`--card`、`--border`、`--primary`、`--font-family`），`MutationObserver` 同帧响应亮色 / 暗色 / 自定义主题切换，零色差接缝；随左侧 Antigravity 会话切换 **1:1 自动联动对应窗口**。 2. **五大主流 Coding Agent 原生流式驱动 + 零代码自定义扩展** | 智能体 | 可执行命令 | 流式通信协议 | 有状态多轮会话保持 | 只读审查 / 落盘改码沙盒 | | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **OpenAI Codex** | `codex` | 常驻 `app-server --stdio` JSON-RPC v2 | `thread/resume` + 安全 `thread/fork` | `--sandbox` + 面板实时命令审批卡 | | **Pi Agent** | `pi` | `pi --mode json -p` 实时事件流 | `--session-id ` | `--tools read,grep,find,ls` / 完整写工具 | | **Claude Code** | `claude` | `claude -p --output-format stream-json` | `--resume ` | `--permission-mode plan` / `acceptEdits` | | **Gemini CLI** | `gemini` | `gemini -p --output-format stream-json` | `--resume ` | 只读模式 / `--yolo` 自动执行 | | **OpenCode** | `opencode` | `opencode run --format json` | `-s ` | 工作区受控执行 | | **自定义 CLI** | *任意命令* | 声明式 `agents.custom.json` | 模板变量注入 | 10 行 JSON 接入 `Aider`、`Qwen`、`Goose` 等 | 3. **「群策圆桌（Council）」多智能体并行会诊** - 在面板底部切换至 **「圆桌群聊 (Council)」** 或通过 `--agents codex,pi,claude` 发起调用，即可将架构方案或未提交的 Git 改动**同时并发派给本机所有已就绪智能体**，同屏对比多方独立审计结论。 4. **由 Antigravity 自主动态决策轮次（1～N 轮自适应收敛）+ 三种工程协作闭环** - **告别机械锁死 2 轮或 3 轮**：由 Antigravity 根据议题复杂度、源码验证结果与收敛信号（`CONVERGED / NEEDS_ROUND`、`PASS / CHANGES_REQUIRED`）动态决定往返 **1～N 轮**——首轮达成共识 1 轮即止不浪费 Token；存在技术分歧或审查出必改项则自动推进第 2、3、4…N 轮深挖或打回重修，直至真正闭环。 - **你提需求 → Antigravity 决策 → 派发任意 Agent 落地执行 → 循环复审 Diff 直至验收通过** - **双 / 多 AI 自适应多轮架构方案碰撞（RFC / Debug）** - **洁净室对抗式代码互审（Review `P0–P3` 分级定位 `文件:行号`）** 5. **双向对等互调与防死循环安全内核** - 安装时自动为本机已安装的 **Codex**（`~/.codex/skills/`）、**Pi**（`~/.pi/agent/skills/`）与 **Claude Code**（`~/.claude/skills/`）挂载反向呼叫 Antigravity 的同侪技能，内置 `AGY_CODEX_PEER_CALL=1` 硬件级防递归死锁锁与跨进程 PID 租约锁。 --- ## 二、30 秒快速安装（Windows / macOS / Linux / WSL 2） **前置条件**： - Node.js **`>= 22.5.0`**（直接复用内置 `node:sqlite`，零 C++ 编译依赖、无需漫长 `npm install`） - 已安装 [Google Antigravity](https://antigravity.google) 及上述**任意一款或多款**本地 Agent CLI（装了哪几款，面板里就会自动点亮哪几款 `已就绪` 标签）。 ### macOS / Linux / WSL 2 ```bash git clone https://github.com/ZJUSCODE/antigravity-agent-bridge.git "$HOME/.gemini/config/plugins/codex-bridge" cd "$HOME/.gemini/config/plugins/codex-bridge" npm run setup npm run doctor ``` ### Windows (PowerShell) ```powershell git clone https://github.com/ZJUSCODE/antigravity-agent-bridge.git "$HOME\.gemini\config\plugins\codex-bridge" cd "$HOME\.gemini\config\plugins\codex-bridge" npm run setup npm run doctor ``` 装好后，直接在 Antigravity 对话框用大白话吩咐即可： - *“打开右侧对讲室，和 **Codex**（或 **Pi** / **Claude Code**）深入碰撞这个模块的架构方案，轮次由你定，达成共识后给我结论”* - *“你先定好接口规范，然后直接派 **Pi** 写前端、派 **Codex** 写后端单测，你循环审查到零缺陷再交付给我”* - *“开一轮 **圆桌群聊（Council）**，让本机所有 Agent 并行审查一下我当前的 Git 未提交改动”* --- ## 三、接入更多自定义 Agent（`agents.custom.json`） 将仓库根目录的 [`agents.example.json`](./agents.example.json) 复制为 `agents.custom.json`，只需 10 行 JSON 即可把 **Aider**、**Qwen Code**、**Goose**、**Kimi CLI** 或团队内部自研 CLI Agent 接入右侧面板与调度脚本！ --- ## 四、一键自检、自动化测试与干净卸载 ```bash npm run doctor # 一键巡检本机已安装的各家 Agent CLI 路径与连接状态 npm test # 运行 17 项并发锁、路径防穿越、多协议流式解析与目录同步测试 npm run uninstall-bridge # 干净移除安装到 ~/.codex、~/.pi、~/.claude 下的同侪技能（保留一切历史对话） ``` ## 社区致谢与开源协议 - **社区认可与致谢**：感谢 **[LINUX DO（linux.do）](https://linux.do/)** 技术社区真诚、友善、团结、专业的开源交流氛围。 - **开源协议**：本项目基于 [MIT License](./LICENSE) 完全开源，欢迎 Star、Fork 与提交新智能体适配器 PR！
